units.source_text: 这附近，没有什么值得特地去登的山。

en.t: Around here, there were no mountains worth going out of one's way to climb.

units.source_text: 检票口的车站职员接过车票，纳闷地目送他远去。

en.t: The station employee at the ticket gate took his ticket and watched him walk away with a puzzled look.

units.source_text: 那男人径自上了车站前的公共汽车，在最靠里边的位子上坐了下来。

en.t: The man went straight onto the bus in front of the station and sat down in the seat farthest inside.

units.source_text: 那是开往山的反方向去的公共汽车。

en.t: It was a bus headed in the opposite direction from the mountains.
